nominations.scope: Own only exact role/action tuple using parent-preserving add/remove; do not DELETE or reconstruct role.

nominations.scope: Own role plus positive application REVISION ID, not stable application ID; string add versus integer read/remove.

nominations.broader_scope_not_solved: Stable-application successor mapping and application lifecycle remain unsolved, not required for fixed revision grant.

nominations.scope: Own existing service ID and one string custom field through setCustomFields/clearCustomFields; no parent CRUD or content edits.

nominations.broader_scope_not_solved: Service protocol/port content read equivalence remains blocked; custom-field ownership does not claim service-content ownership.

nominations.scope: Own whole notification email set for one aws/azure/gcp provider; destroy explicitly clears only emails.

nominations.broader_scope_not_solved: Full protection/CD-settings reset remains unsolved; no PUT or protection toggles authorized.

nominations.scope: Tenant singleton, replacement-only, explicit nonempty issue type/priority; write-only documented converted token.

nominations.scope: Replacement-only exact threat_type/list_type/destination tuple; always selected nonempty destination on DELETE.

nominations.broader_scope_not_solved: Do not promise concurrency-safe insertion or normalized aliases; missing PATCH is not a lifecycle blocker.
